description: Search 470,000+ artworks at The Metropolitan Museum of Art by keyword, artist, medium, department, date range, or geography. Returns object IDs — use met.details for full metadata and images. CC0 public domain (Met Museum)

date_begin.description: Start year for date range filter (e.g. 1800). Use with date_end.

date_end.description: End year for date range filter (e.g. 1900). Use with date_begin.

department_id.description: Department filter: 1=American Decorative Arts, 3=Ancient Near Eastern Art, 6=Asian Art, 9=Drawings and Prints, 11=European Paintings, 13=Greek and Roman Art, 17=Medieval Art, 21=Modern Art

has_images.description: Only return artworks with images (default: true)

query.description: Search keyword — artist, title, medium, or subject (e.g. "monet", "sunflowers", "greek vase", "armor")

name: met.art.search

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Search Met Museum Artworks
